studies.notes: The saved article prints recruitment and randomization counts, but no explicit total or per-arm analyzed participant counts for the creativity acquisition or transfer outcomes (PDF pp. 5-6, Section 3.1 Creativity performance and Fig. 2). No participant exclusions or dropout counts are reported for these outcomes. The screening form derived its analyzed counts from degrees of freedom; those derived counts are not accepted here. Study and arm n_analyzed therefore remain null. No count was inferred from degrees of freedom, randomized arm counts, or plotted points. No different analyzed participant count is printed for the other creativity outcomes. The complete saved markdown was read, including Appendix A and references. Quotes were checked against PDF text extracted with pymupdf; line wrapping and discretionary hyphens were normalized. Figures 1 and 2 were also inspected in memory. The separate supplement, including Table S2 cited for descriptive means and SDs on PDF p. 5, is not on file (supplement-manifest.json, c072, files is empty). Appendix A on PDF p. 12 points to https://doi.org/10.1016/j.chbah.2026.100288. Requests with Python urllib and User-Agent atlas-screening/0.1 to that DOI and to the ScienceDirect article URL named in retrieval.json (https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2949882126000393) both failed with WinError 10013. Supplementary participant counts could not be verified.
